title: Range-Time Intensity Scope
text: Range-time intensity scope, 1 input, no direct feedthrough; {Range Offset (m)} sets the range offset, {Time Span (s)} sets the time span of display, {Range Resolution (m)} sets the range difference between samples, {Time Resolution (s)} sets the time difference between rows, {Show Grid} shows Cartesian grid overlay, {Show Ticks} shows tick value labels, {Range Label} sets the range axis label, {Time Label} sets the time axis label Time History, {Title} sets the window title and {Colorbar Label} sets the color bar. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input data real-valued length- M vector

params.name: Time Span (s)
params.values: Time span of display 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Range Resolution (m)
params.values: Range difference between samples 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Time Resolution (s)
params.values: Time difference between rows 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Show Grid
params.values: Show Cartesian grid overlay on (default) | off

params.name: Show Ticks
params.values: Show tick value labels on (default) | off

params.name: Time Label
params.values: Time axis label Time History (s)’ (default) | string
